description: Repo-scale (aspnet-helpdesk): POST /api/tickets/bulk-reassign must validate every ticketId exists BEFORE reassigning any of them (atomic), plus a destination-agent maxOpenTickets check
prompts: Agents gain an optional `maxOpenTickets` field (a positive integer, or null/omitted meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/agents and return it in agent responses. Add `POST /api/tickets/bulk-reassign`: body `{ ticketIds: [...], toAgentId }`, reassigning every given ticket to the destination agent. This must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY ticketId in the request refers to an existing ticket BEFORE reassigning any of them - if one doesn't exist, respond 404 and leave every ticket's agent exactly as it was, not partially reassigned; (2) validate that moving the WHOLE batch into the destination agent (only counting tickets that are currently open/in_progress and not already assigned to them) wouldn't push their open-ticket count over maxOpenTickets, again before reassigning anything.
name: add_csharp_helpdesk_bulk_reassign_atomic
